name: Requirements.xlsx
text:
--- Sheet: Sheet1 ---
			1	Certification Information	FCC, RoHS
			2		Can we obtain the necessary certifications for sale in Japan under our company name?
			3	Packaging	I understand the text on the label is in English. Is it possible to have it translated into Japanese for this order?
			4		Please tell me the contents of the label. Please send me a PDF of the label currently attached to the product.
			5		Does the sample feature your company's logo?
			6		Is your company's logo on the packaging?
			7		When placing a formal order, will the logo be printed on the product, packaging, and our label?
			8	Power Supply	Please list the compatible power supplies your company recommends. PSE-certified products are mandatory for sale in Japan.
			9	Warranty System	Do you have an RMA warranty system?
			10		How many years is the manufacturer’s warranty?
			11		What is your policy regarding products whose warranty period has expired?
			12		Please describe your technical support system and the duration of support after purchasing your products. (Procedures for handling failures that occur within the warranty period, and selection of support personnel)
			13	Sales Track Record	Have you sold your products in Japan before?
			14	Sales Track Record	What is your sales track record to date?
			15	Failure Rate	Please provide the failure rate for this product.
			16	AI WATCH DOG	Please tell me how to verify that this feature is functioning properly.
			17	Extension	What is the transmission speed at a distance of 250 meters?
